name: Photoroom
tagline: Photoroom is an AI-powered photo editing app specialised in product photography and portrait retouching. It removes and replaces backgrounds instantly, adjusts lighting, generates lifestyle scenes from product shots, and batch-processes hundreds of images via its API. E-commerce sellers and marketers use Photoroom to produce consistent, professional product images without a photography studio.
